title: Find subscriptions
intro: Upload a bank or card statement. Safi picks out the subscriptions and shows what you could save.

upload.heading: Your statement
upload.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file
upload.drop_active: Drop the file to scan it
upload.sources: Works with Revolut, AIB and Amex statements, and invoice exports from Stripe, GitHub and Vercel.
upload.privacy: The file is read once to find subscriptions. Safi keeps only the detected subscriptions, not your other transactions.
upload.wrong_type: Choose a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
upload.too_large: This file is too big. Try a shorter date range.
upload.too_large_compressed: This file is still too big after compressing. Try a shorter date range.
upload.too_many_rows: This file has too many rows. Try a shorter date range.
upload.read_failed: Couldn't read this file. Check it's a CSV or Excel export.
upload.scan_failed: Couldn't scan this file. Please try again.
upload.empty_file: This file has no transactions in it. Export your statement again and upload that file.
upload.not_statement: This doesn't look like a statement. Choose a CSV or Excel export from your bank or card.

mapping.heading: Check the columns
mapping.hint: Safi couldn't tell which column is which. Pick the date, description and amount.
mapping.default_currency_hint: Used when the file has no currency column.
mapping.missing_required: Pick the date, description and amount columns to continue.

resume.title: Continue your last scan
resume.count: {count, plural, one {# to review} other {# to review}}

report.label: What you could save
report.of_total: of {amount}/yr across {count, plural, one {# subscription} other {# subscriptions}}
report.found: {count, plural, one {# subscription found} other {# subscriptions found}}
report.nothing_wasted: Nothing looks wasted — nice. Confirm what you still use below.
report.none_found: No subscriptions found in this file. Try a longer date range or another account.

list.hint: Pick what to do with each one. Not sure is a safe choice: Safi reminds you before it renews.
list.save_hint: Pick a choice for at least one subscription.
list.need_amount: {count, plural, one {Add the price for # subscription before saving.} other {Add the price for # subscriptions before saving.}}
list.partial: {saved, plural, one {# saved} other {# saved}}. {failed, plural, one {# needs a look} other {# need a look}}.

item.renews_in: {days, plural, =0 {Renews today} =1 {Renews tomorrow} other {Renews in # days}}
item.trial_ends: {days, plural, =0 {Trial ends today} =1 {Trial ends tomorrow} other {Trial ends in # days}}

decision_hint.not_sure: Saved with a reminder, so you can decide before it renews.
decision_hint.cancel: Saved with a reminder to cancel before the next charge.
decision_hint.not_subscription: Removed from this list. Nothing is saved.

item.name: Name

errors.amount_required: Add the price to save this one.
errors.not_found: This one is no longer available. Scan the file again.
errors.failed: Couldn't save this one. Please try again.

done.title: All set
done.summary: {saved, plural, one {# subscription saved} other {# subscriptions saved}} · {reminders, plural, =0 {no reminders} one {# reminder set} other {# reminders set}}
done.hidden: {count, plural, one {# hidden as not a subscription} other {# hidden as not subscriptions}}
done.reminder: Reminder {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before {date}
done.reminder_each: Reminder {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before each renewal

entry.data_title: Find subscriptions in a bank statement
entry.data_body: See what you pay for, what renews soon and what you could cancel.
